faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Everything you need to know about our programs and services.
faq.a1: We offer English, French, German, and Spanish language training, structured according to the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR) from A1 to B2. Other language courses are available on request.
faq.q2: What is the CEFR and how does it apply to your courses?
faq.a2: The CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference) is an international standard for language proficiency. Our courses are aligned to CEFR levels A1 (beginner) through B2 (upper-intermediate), ensuring globally recognized progression.
faq.a3: Each CEFR level (A1, A2, B1, B2) is divided into 3 packs. Pack 1 includes a material fee. Packs 2 and 3 cover tuition only. You can progress at your own pace.
faq.q4: What are the class formats available?
faq.a4: We offer Intensive (5 sessions/week, 10 hours/week, 4 weeks) and Semi-Intensive (3 sessions/week, 6 hours/week, 6 weeks) formats, primarily online with select in-person options.
faq.q5: Do I get a certificate after completing a level?
faq.a5: Yes! Learners receive a certificate upon successful completion of each CEFR level. We also prepare students for international exams like TEF, TCF, DELF, DALF, and Goethe-Zertifikat.
faq.q6: How long does it take to complete one level?
faq.a6: Each pack takes approximately 4–6 weeks depending on the format chosen. A full level (3 packs) typically takes 12–18 weeks.
faq.q7: Do you offer exam preparation courses?
faq.a7: Yes. We offer intensive exam preparation for TEF, TCF, DELF, DALF, and Goethe-Zertifikat. The program covers 40 hours over 7 weeks with 3 sessions per week. Contact languageservices@edulearningimmersion.org for details.
faq.q8: Which international exams can I prepare for?
faq.a8: We prepare students for TEF (Test d'Évaluation de Français), TCF (Test de Connaissance du Français), DELF/DALF (Diplôme d'Études en Langue Française), and Goethe-Zertifikat for German.
faq.q9: Are exams included in the course fee?
faq.a9: Exam preparation is a separate program from general language courses. Exam registration fees are paid directly to the examining body and are not included in our tuition.
faq.q10: What translation services do you offer?
faq.a10: We offer document translation (legal, medical, technical, business), certified translation, website localization, and multilingual desktop publishing across multiple language pairs.
faq.q11: What types of interpretation do you provide?
faq.a11: We provide Simultaneous Interpretation (₦112,500/hr), Consecutive Interpretation (₦75,000/hr), Liaison Interpretation (₦67,500/hr), and Remote Interpretation (₦60,000/hr). Urgent rates and full-day discounts (15%) are available.
faq.q12: Do you offer proofreading and editing services?
faq.a12: Yes. We offer Basic Proofreading (from ₦4,000/page), Professional Editing (from ₦6,000/page), and Premium Rewriting (from ₦10,000/page). Express delivery surcharges apply for urgent work.
faq.q13: How do I request a quote for translation or interpretation?
faq.a13: Visit our Translation & Interpretation page and fill out the quote request form with your document details, language pair, and deadline. We respond within 24 hours.
faq.q14: Do you offer language programs for schools?
faq.a14: Yes. We partner with primary and secondary schools to deliver structured English, French, and German programs tailored to the school curriculum and schedule.
faq.a15: Absolutely. We offer professional development workshops and training programs for language teachers, focusing on CEFR methodology and modern teaching techniques.
faq.q16: Do you provide after-school language clubs?
faq.a16: Yes. We can set up after-school language clubs and extracurricular programs for students, including conversation practice, cultural activities, and exam preparation.
faq.a17: We work with school administrators to assess needs, design a tailored program, deploy qualified instructors, and provide regular progress reports. Contact us for a school partnership proposal.
faq.a18: Yes. Our immersion programs provide intensive language and cultural experiences. Contact us for upcoming immersion schedules and destinations.
faq.q19: What does an immersion program include?
faq.a19: Immersion programs include intensive daily classes, cultural activities, real-world practice sessions, and guided excursions — all designed for rapid language acquisition.
faq.q20: Who can join an immersion program?
faq.a20: Immersion programs are open to individuals of all levels (A1–B2). Corporate groups and school delegations can also arrange custom immersion experiences.
faq.q21: Do you offer digital marketing services?
faq.a21: Yes. We provide digital communication solutions including social media strategy, content creation, multilingual digital marketing, and brand communication consulting.
faq.q22: Can you help with multilingual content creation?
faq.a22: Absolutely. We create professional multilingual content for websites, social media, marketing campaigns, and corporate communications in English, French, and other languages.
faq.q23: How can my organization partner with Edu Learning & Immersion?
faq.a23: We welcome partnerships with academic institutions, corporate organizations, NGOs, government agencies, and international bodies. Visit our Partnerships page or contact us directly.
faq.q24: Do you work with NGOs and international organizations?
faq.a24: Yes. We support multilingual communication for humanitarian, development, and diplomatic projects through language training, translation, and interpretation services.
faq.q25: Can language teachers join your platform?
faq.a25: Yes. We welcome qualified teachers of English, French, German, Spanish, Dutch, Chinese, and other languages to teach under the Edu Learning & Immersion platform. Contact us to apply.
faq.a26: Yes. We offer free consultations for corporate training, school partnerships, and large-scale translation projects. Use our contact form or WhatsApp to schedule one.
faq.q27: How do I contact Edu Learning & Immersion?
faq.a27: Email us at contact@edulearningimmersion.org, WhatsApp us at +234 916 078 4634, or use the contact form on our website. We typically respond within minutes on WhatsApp.
faq.q28: Where is Edu Learning & Immersion located?
faq.a28: We are based in Enugu and Lagos, Nigeria, with services available nationwide and internationally. 46 Kenneth Road, Achara Layout, Enugu & University of Lagos, Akoka, Yaba, Lagos.
faq.q29: Are courses available for complete beginners?
faq.a29: Yes. Our A1 level is designed specifically for complete beginners with no prior knowledge of the language.
faq.q30: Can I switch between online and in-person formats?
faq.a30: Yes. Learners can switch between online and in-person formats between packs, subject to availability.
faq.a31: Yes. We offer special pricing for groups, corporate teams, and institutional partnerships. Contact us for a custom quote.
faq.q32: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a32: We accept bank transfers, mobile payments, and card payments. Payment plans are available for multi-pack enrollments.

cefr.intro: The Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) provides an international standard for describing language ability. It evaluates learners across four core competencies: listening, reading, speaking, and writing. Applicable for all courses (French, English, German, Spanish, etc.)

A1.label: Beginner
A1.desc: Learners can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases. They can introduce themselves, ask simple questions, and interact in a limited way when communication is slow and clear.
A1.skill_listening: Understand familiar words and basic phrases.
A1.skill_reading: Recognize simple words and short sentences.
A1.skill_speaking: Introduce themselves and ask or answer basic questions.
A1.skill_writing: Write short messages and complete forms with personal details.
A1.sub1_p2: Introduce oneself and interact at a basic level.
A1.sub1_p3: Write name, address, and personal information.
A1.sub1_skills: Use basic expressions, introduce yourself, complete simple personal information, interact slowly and clearly.
A1.sub2_p1: Understand phrases related to immediate needs.
A1.sub2_p2: Ask and answer simple daily-life questions.
A1.sub2_p3: Read short texts and write simple sentences.
A1.sub2_skills: Understand everyday phrases, ask simple questions, read short texts, participate in guided conversations.
A1.sub3_p3: Write brief texts on familiar topics.
A1.sub3_skills: Describe familiar topics, hold short conversations, write simple coherent texts.

A2.label: Elementary
A2.desc: Learners understand frequently used expressions related to everyday situations such as work, family, and shopping. They can manage routine tasks and simple exchanges.
A2.skill_listening: Understand simple instructions and common expressions.
A2.skill_writing: Produce short messages and personal descriptions.
A2.sub1_p1: Use common expressions for daily communication.
A2.sub1_skills: Communicate in daily situations, describe surroundings, read notices, write short messages.
A2.sub2_p1: Participate in direct conversations on familiar topics.
A2.sub2_skills: Participate in simple conversations and understand common spoken language.
A2.sub3_skills: Describe experiences and plans, understand frequent expressions and simple texts.

B1.label: Intermediate
B1.desc: Learners understand the main points of clear communication on familiar topics and can manage most situations encountered while traveling in regions where the language is spoken.
B1.skill_listening: Understand main ideas of discussions on familiar subjects.
B1.skill_speaking: Share experiences, opinions, and future plans.
B1.sub1_skills: Understand familiar discussions, participate in conversations, write short narratives.
B1.sub2_p1: Understand texts related to personal interests.
B1.sub2_skills: Express opinions clearly and engage in varied exchanges.
B1.sub3_skills: Communicate more spontaneously, understand longer texts, develop arguments.

B2.label: Upper-Intermediate
B2.desc: Learners understand the main ideas of complex texts in professional and personal contexts. They interact fluently and spontaneously with increasing accuracy.
B2.skill_listening: Understand lectures, discussions, and audiovisual content.
B2.skill_speaking: Express ideas clearly and in detail.
B2.skill_writing: Produce structured texts presenting arguments and opinions.
B2.sub1_p1: Understand complex texts on concrete and abstract topics.
B2.sub1_p2: Participate in professional or technical discussions.
B2.sub1_p3: Write detailed texts on familiar subjects.
B2.sub1_skills: Understand complex texts and participate in professional discussions.
B2.sub2_skills: Explain viewpoints clearly and summarize specialized content.
B2.sub3_p3: Produce clear, structured, and well-argued written texts.
B2.sub3_skills: Communicate fluently and produce structured, detailed written work.

about.storyText2: Our approach combines CEFR-structured methodology with practical, immersive techniques, creating programs that deliver measurable results for individuals and organizations.
about.v1Desc: We are committed to delivering the highest quality services through certified instructors, proven methodologies, and continuous improvement.
about.v2Desc: We embrace modern teaching techniques, technology, and creative solutions to enhance learning and service delivery.
about.v3Desc: We operate with transparency, honesty, and ethical standards in all our interactions with clients, partners, and stakeholders.
about.v4Desc: We foster understanding and respect for diverse cultures, enabling effective communication across linguistic and cultural boundaries.
about.v5Desc: We place our clients at the center of everything we do, tailoring solutions to meet their specific needs, goals, and expectations.
about.tm1Desc: Expert in foreign language education, specializing in French and innovative pedagogy. Over 11 years of experience in teaching and educational project management, creating immersive and digitally connected learning solutions.
about.tm2Desc: Native French speaker and specialist in French as a Foreign Language (FLE). Experienced in teaching and academic administration with the Alliance Française. Leads innovative, high-impact learning initiatives with expertise in the CEFR framework.
about.tm3Desc: Skilled in digital communication, content creation, and stakeholder engagement. Supports the development and implementation of effective communication strategies.
about.tm4Desc: Combining expertise in administrative management and language program coordination. Ensures smooth operations while delivering high-quality, learner-centered language experiences.
